newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Plasma & Materials cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Plasma & Materials cut.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers said it downgraded Plasma & Materials Technologies Inc to hold from strong buy.
-- cut the 1997 earnings estimate to $0.10 a share from $0.85 and the 1998 estimate to $0.75 a share from $1.10.
-- said the company does not have sufficient sales orders to cover its $50 million in inventory.
-- said orders have picked up, but not enough for the company to show year-over-year revenue growth in the first and second quarter.
-- said has concerns about the company's ability to handle its $100 million in debt.
-- said does not expect Plasma & Materials to return to profitability until the second quarter of 1997 "at the earliest."
